offer.text: I'm trying a new trim — copper takes a lovely shine. Sixteen ingots and I'll plate a parade set.

accept.text: It'll green with age, but oh, the gleam at first! Thank you.

decline.text: Plain steel for the parade, then. Dull.

ready.text: Sixteen bright ingots! The captain's armor will dazzle.

complete.text: A craftsman appreciates good materials. As do I, you.
